{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjccM8AAAABZb8xag", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IfzhDDMY4", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3If", "number": 33, "title": "Initialize model-specific SP and DS at firmware-free cartridge handoff", "body": "## Problem

`Cpu::default()` initializes SP and DS to zero. `Machine::load_rom`, `restart` and compatible `change_model` reuse that state. The documented policy requires cartridges to initialize everything else, and existing probes initialize their stack and segments before testing hardware.

The [WSHWTest startup observations](https://github.com/FluBBaOfWard/WSHWTest/blob/34e33d5bfaaabb8b09fa5a557e409efe9fbfd979/README.md#start-registers) instead report SP=0x2000 on all three models, with DS=0xFF00 on WonderSwan and DS=0xFE00 on WonderSwan Color/SwanCrystal. Software inspecting or relying on those incoming values receives incorrect state. Commercial-title impact remains unmeasured.

## Expected outcome

Successful firmware-free cartridge entry supplies those established SP/DS values consistently on load, restart and compatible model changes. Select DS by physical console model, including Color/Crystal running mono-compatible cartridges. Keep unloaded initialization distinct from cartridge handoff.

This resolves the evidenced register mismatch; complete firmware services and authentic initialization of other fields remain separate hardware-readiness gaps.

## Context

Baseline: `83df7ffa4c068cb30799401e3b07c6efb4c05e46`, matching clean local HEAD and remote main. Relevant code: `crates/ws-core/src/cpu.rs`, `lib.rs`, `bus.rs`; policy: `docs/hardware-subset.md`, “Firmware-free startup and reset.” Open Issues, including PRs, returned empty; closed-work history contains no equivalent startup correction.

The pinned [experiment assembly](https://github.com/FluBBaOfWard/WSHWTest/blob/34e33d5bfaaabb8b09fa5a557e409efe9fbfd979/WSHWTest.asm#L49-L74) records incoming SP before replacing it and records DS before initializing it. It overwrites SS first, so this evidence does not establish incoming SS. The author qualifies interpretations; the observations are incomplete, and no physical execution was performed here. Boot_ROM wiki access returned 403; the accessible experiment supplies the bounded requirement.

Correction record: old AI-authored assumption—zero SP/DS and mandatory cartridge initialization suffice for handoff. Corrected requirement—supply the experimentally established entry values. Rationale—the cartridge-visible state differs from the existing policy. Preserve other deterministic defaults as explicitly synthetic unless stronger evidence establishes a correction; do not copy uncertain startup I/O tables wholesale.

[PR #32](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/pull/32) and its [saved validation](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/83df7ffa4c068cb30799401e3b07c6efb4c05e46/docs/issue-31-validation.md) report passing native/build/Chromium checks and Coordinator acceptance review. Existing startup tests establish mapping, not incoming SP/DS fidelity. These are prior reported results, not checks run during this planning task.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Implement an explicit cartridge-handoff initialization step supplying SP=0x2000 and model-dependent DS before cartridge instructions execute. Keep unloaded/reset state distinct; preserve the existing FFFF:0000 entry, footer execution and common/extended mapper initialization.
- [ ] Add literal expected-value tests for every model across successful load, restart, cartridge replacement, same-model restart and transitions between compatible models. Include mono-compatible headers on Color/Crystal and Color headers on both supported models. Exercise previously changed SP/DS so lifecycle tests detect stale state.
- [ ] Verify failed ROM loads and incompatible model changes preserve the running state. Preserve A0 header-seeded controls, internal EEPROM protection, cartridge saves and independent retained console records.
- [ ] Add an original source-included CC0 cartridge probe that captures incoming SP and DS before replacing either, using explicitly established destination addressing rather than assuming DS. Execute the cartridge through normal footer/banking paths; assert CPU-written markers natively and through production Wasm/browser load, restart and compatible model changes. Expected values must be independent literals, not computed from the new initializer.
- [ ] Preserve existing three-model gameplay, audio/PCM, GDMA/SDMA/Hyper Voice, SRAM/cartridge EEPROM/internal EEPROM, timing, input/orientation and browser persistence behavior. Keep the core browser-independent, ROMs local and ownership/provenance intact; add no proprietary firmware, commercial ROMs, copied emulator code or title-specific paths.
- [ ] Coordinator runs and records `python3 fixtures/build.py --check`, `python3 demo/build.py --check`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo test --workspace --locked`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `git diff --check`. In `web`, run `npm run build:wasm`, `npm run build`, then both complete `npm run test:browser` and `npm run test:compat` suites sequentially against the production preview, including the new probe.
- [ ] Update startup documentation, API comments and fixture provenance. Record the correction, source applicability, synthetic defaults and unresolved firmware/authentication limitations. Coordinator reviews the final diff and actual validation against every acceptance item before merge; report failures and unperformed checks honestly. Evidence-backed technical corrections need no human approval or independent AI re-review, and must not weaken requirements to accommodate failures.

## Optional validation

Compare additional lawfully available startup experiments or another browser engine. Record inspected source separately from executed results. Commercial ROMs, proprietary firmware and human gameplay are unnecessary for acceptance.

## Required post-merge verification

None.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WonderSwan-family hardware goal.
Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance criteria when primary hardware
specifications establish the correction. Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
